dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a certified matrix-norm structure, this is its real-valued evaluation function on n-by-n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It evaluates the run's matrix norm at the projected error matrix, producing the left-hand side of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the indexed type of proof-carrying runs of dimension n. Its constructor packages all numerical data, matrices, coefficients, algebraic relationships, and bounds listed in D014.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is universally quantified over every inhabitant of this certified-run type; it does not assert that such an inhabitant exists.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the second constructor field of a run, namely its certified matrix-norm structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the norm used to measure the projected error and all matrix quantities in the hypotheses and bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a run, this defines E = ((C - AB) - ΔAΔB) - R, where C is the computed product, A and B are the exact matrices, ΔA and ΔB are their perturbations, and R is the higher-order remainder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the matrix whose norm is bounded. It is not the full error C-AB: the perturbation cross-product ΔAΔB and the certified remainder R are explicitly subtracted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines the real number μ(n) ε N(A) N(B) + (N(A) η_B + η_A N(B)), with η_A and η_B the supplied left and right inherited-error bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is exactly the right-hand side of the asserted norm inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of certified norm-like functionals on n-by-n real matrices, constructed with the nonnegativity, definiteness, absolute homogeneity, triangle, and submultiplicativity axioms in D020.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the allowed matrix measurements to abstract submultiplicative matrix norms on square real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the fifteenth constructor field of a run, the n-by-n real matrix C designated as the computed product.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the computed output appearing in the projected error E.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the third constructor field of a run, the positive real parameter ε.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales the local-error term linearly and the removed remainder bound quadratically.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the eleventh constructor field of a run, the exact left n-by-n real matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the exact product AB, the retained inherited-error term AΔB, and the right-hand-side factors N(A).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the twelfth constructor field of a run, the exact right n-by-n real matrix B.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the exact product AB, the retained inherited-error term ΔAB, and the right-hand-side factors N(B).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the seventeenth constructor field of a run, the higher-order remainder matrix R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is included in the certified equation for C but is explicitly subtracted from E, so its κ ε² bound is not needed to estimate E.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the eighteenth constructor field of a run, the nonnegative left inherited-error scalar η_A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds N(ΔA) and contributes the term η_A N(B) to the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the thirteenth constructor field of a run, the left perturbation matrix ΔA.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its quadratic product ΔAΔB is removed from E, while its linear product ΔAB remains and is bounded using N(ΔA) ≤ η_A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructor takes, in order: n>0; a certified matrix norm N; ε with ε>0; μ:ℕ→ℝ with μ(k)≥0 for every k; a natural degree d; a nonnegative growth constant C_μ; the bound μ(k)≤C_μ(k:ℝ)^d for every k; matrices A, B, ΔA, ΔB, C, L, R; scalars η_A and η_B with both nonnegative; a scalar κ with κ≥0; the equation C=((A+ΔA)(B+ΔB)+L)+R; and the bounds N(L)≤μ(n)εN(A)N(B), N(ΔA)≤η_A, N(ΔB)≤η_B, and N(R)≤κ ε².
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The decomposition equation makes E exactly AΔB + ΔAB + L. The bounds on L, ΔA, and ΔB, together with the norm axioms, yield the conclusion. Positivity of n and ε, polynomial growth of μ, nonnegativity proofs, and the bound on R constrain admissible runs but are not needed directly after R is canceled.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the fifth constructor field of a run, the nonnegative coefficient function μ:ℕ→ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only its value μ(n) occurs in the local first-order-error bound and final inequality; its global polynomial-growth certificate does not otherwise enter the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the nineteenth constructor field of a run, the nonnegative right inherited-error scalar η_B.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds N(ΔB) and contributes the term N(A)η_B to the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the fourteenth constructor field of a run, the right perturbation matrix ΔB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its quadratic product ΔAΔB is removed from E, while its linear product AΔB remains and is bounded using N(ΔB) ≤ η_B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, this is Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real: the type of square n-by-n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All exact matrices, perturbations, computed output, local error, remainder, and the projected error have this same square dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary matrix multiplication: (AB)ᵢₖ is the finite sum over j in Fin n of AᵢⱼBⱼₖ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines AB, ΔAΔB, the perturbed-input product, and the submultiplicativity axiom used to bound retained product terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a matrix norm N from a function on n-by-n real matrices satisfying N(A)≥0; N(A)=0 iff A=0; N(cA)=|c|N(A); N(A+B)≤N(A)+N(B); and N(AB)≤N(A)N(B).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Triangle inequality and submultiplicativity directly bound AΔB + ΔAB + L. The remaining axioms restrict the admitted functional but are not essential to this particular estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an ordered type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instance, it expresses every non-strict real inequality, including the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the matrix dimension n, indices for μ, the polynomial degree, and natural exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Matrix entries, norm values, ε, coefficient values, inherited-error bounds, and all scalar inequalities are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard less-than-or-equal order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the mathematical meaning of the conclusion as an ordinary real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type whose elements correspond to natural numbers less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes both rows and columns of every n-by-n matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the applicable heterogeneous addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes real addition in bounds and pointwise matrix addition in the perturbed inputs and decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the applicable heterogeneous multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes the real scalar products in coefficient bounds; matrix multiplication is supplied by the specialized matrix instance.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the applicable heterogeneous subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the three successive matrix subtractions defining E.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips matrices with entrywise subtraction inherited from their entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Consequently, E = ((C-AB)-ΔAΔB)-R is computed entrywise before its norm is taken.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the real terms on the right-hand side and supplies entrywise addition for real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms all scalar products in the local-error, growth, remainder, and final bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the entrywise scalar subtraction used by matrix subtraction in E.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary addition instance into homogeneous heterogeneous-addition notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the displayed additions are the standard real or matrix additions selected by type.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary multiplication instance into homogeneous heterogeneous-multiplication notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures scalar products in the bounds are ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary subtraction instance into homogeneous heterogeneous-subtraction notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the subtractions defining E use ordinary entrywise matrix subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses norm definiteness and, crucially, the exact certified equation linking C to the product of perturbed inputs plus L and R.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the inner index of square-matrix multiplication a finite summation domain.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the applicable exponentiation operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents (k:ℝ)^d in the growth bound and ε² in the remainder bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the strict-order relation supplied by an ordered type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the assumptions 0<n and 0<ε.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m→n→α.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the underlying representation of all matrices as functions on finite row and column indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips matrices with pointwise addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines A+ΔA, B+ΔB, and the matrix sums with L and R in the certified decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines standard matrix multiplication by finite dot products over the shared index type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives all matrix products their usual algebraic meaning and supports expansion of (A+ΔA)(B+ΔB).

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This provides natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it gives the ordinary powers (k:ℝ)^d and ε².

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This casts a natural number into a type with a natural-number embedding.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets k as a real number in the polynomial-growth expression C_μ(k:ℝ)^d.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural numeral in the target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies numerical constants such as 0 and 2 in positivity assumptions and powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the commutative additive-monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits finite sums of real products in standard matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes 0<ε ordinary strict positivity of ε.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines natural powers of real quantities in the growth and remainder bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the standard embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the real value of k in the polynomial-growth bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in nonnegativity, positivity, and norm-definiteness assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets numeral 0 using a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects written zeroes in real assumptions to the actual real zero.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary power operation into heterogeneous-power notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the displayed powers are ordinary real powers with natural exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the dimension requirement 0<n the usual positivity condition on n.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural numeral as itself in ℕ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural constants such as the 0 in 0<n and the exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.id
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives a commutative semiring its identity algebra structure over itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For ℝ it underlies scalar multiplication of real matrices by real numbers in the norm-homogeneity axiom.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.toSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real scalar multiplication used in cA.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the identity real-algebra structure used for scalar multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HSMul.hSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the applicable heterogeneous scalar-multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the scalar multiple cA in the absolute-homogeneity axiom of the matrix norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical equivalence between two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the norm-definiteness condition N(A)=0 if and only if A is the zero matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.smul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips matrices with entrywise scalar multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Thus cA in the norm axiom is the matrix obtained by multiplying every entry of A by c.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips matrices with the entrywise zero matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives meaning to A=0 in the norm-definiteness axiom.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides negation and subtraction and participates in defining real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instCommSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the commutative-semiring structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the identity real-algebra and hence real scalar multiplication of matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the lattice order structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the definition of |c| used in absolute homogeneity.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real c, this defines |c| as max(c,-c).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears only in the matrix-norm homogeneity axiom N(cA)=|c|N(A).

dependency_coverage.name: instHSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary scalar action into heterogeneous scalar-multiplication notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures cA in the norm axiom uses the standard pointwise real action on matrices.

binders: First, an implicit natural number n is universally quantified.
Second, run : LocalDef002 n is universally quantified. It is a proof-carrying certified run, not an existential witness in the conclusion.

Unpacking run, its constructor arguments occur in this exact order: a proof h_n of 0<n; a matrix norm N; ε; a proof of 0<ε; μ:ℕ→ℝ; a proof that μ is pointwise nonnegative; a degree d:ℕ; a growth constant C_μ; a proof C_μ≥0; a proof of the global growth bound; matrices A, B, ΔA, ΔB, C, L, R; scalars η_A and η_B; proofs η_A≥0 and η_B≥0; a coefficient κ; a proof κ≥0; the decomposition equality; the local-error bound; the left-perturbation bound; the right-perturbation bound; and the remainder bound.
All seven matrix fields A, B, ΔA, ΔB, C, L, and R are square n-by-n matrices over ℝ.

Here A and B are the exact left and right matrices, ΔA and ΔB are their perturbations, C is the designated computed product, L is a local first-order-error matrix, and R is a higher-order remainder matrix.
hypotheses: N is an abstract matrix norm on n-by-n real matrices: N(X)≥0; N(X)=0 iff X=0; N(cX)=|c|N(X); N(X+Y)≤N(X)+N(Y); and N(XY)≤N(X)N(Y).
The parameter ε is strictly positive.
The supplied degree d is natural, C_μ≥0, and for every k∈ℕ, μ(k)≤C_μ(k:ℝ)^d.
The inherited-error scalars satisfy η_A≥0 and η_B≥0.
The computed matrix is linked to the perturbed inputs by the exact equality C=((A+ΔA)(B+ΔB)+L)+R.
The perturbations satisfy N(ΔA)≤η_A and N(ΔB)≤η_B.
conclusions: Using the certified equality for C and distributivity of ordinary matrix multiplication, E is exactly AΔB+ΔAB+L. Thus the conclusion bounds the retained two inherited linear terms and the local error.
mathematical_definitions: An n-by-n real matrix is a function Fin n→Fin n→ℝ.
Matrix multiplication is standard finite-sum multiplication: (XY)ᵢₖ=Σⱼ XᵢⱼYⱼₖ.
N denotes the run's abstract submultiplicative matrix norm.
A=exactLeft, B=exactRight, ΔA=leftPerturbation, ΔB=rightPerturbation, C=computedProduct, L=localFirstOrderError, and R=higherOrderRemainder.
The full computed error would instead be C-AB=AΔB+ΔAB+ΔAΔB+L+R.
The projected error removes precisely ΔAΔB and R, leaving E=AΔB+ΔAB+L.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive matrix dimension n and every certified run carrying an abstract submultiplicative norm, a positive ε, coefficient data, exact matrices A and B, perturbations ΔA and ΔB, a computed matrix C, a local error L, and a remainder R satisfying the stated decomposition and bounds, the norm of the explicitly projected error ((C-AB)-ΔAΔB)-R is at most μ(n)εN(A)N(B)+N(A)η_B+η_A N(B). The certified decomposition identifies that projected error with AΔB+ΔAB+L, so the estimate follows from the local-error bound, perturbation bounds, triangle inequality, and submultiplicativity.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The target quantifies over a single packaged run after n. It asserts no existence of runs, matrices, norms, or certificates.
Because constructing a run requires 0<n, the theorem is vacuous at n=0.
All matrices are square n-by-n real matrices; rectangular matrices, complex matrices, vectors, and other scalar domains are excluded.
The bounded quantity is not the full computed error C-AB. The quadratic perturbation product ΔAΔB and the entire remainder R are explicitly removed before measuring the error.
The retained terms AΔB and ΔAB are called first-order only in an algebraic sense. No hypothesis requires ΔA or ΔB to scale with ε.

The inherited bounds η_A and η_B are supplied after the matrices and may be chosen arbitrarily large subject only to nonnegativity and the two norm inequalities. Hence they do not encode uniform smallness or convergence as ε tends to zero.

The coefficient κ is supplied after R and ε. At a single positive ε it can be inflated to certify a large remainder, and the resulting remainder bound has no effect on the conclusion because R is subtracted exactly.

The function μ is supplied after ε but before the matrices. It is nonnegative and globally polynomially bounded, but it is not required to be uniform across different runs or different ε values. At one fixed ε, a sufficiently large admissible μ(n) can substantially weaken the local-error condition.
The polynomial-growth condition holds for every natural k, including k=0. If d>0, it forces μ(0)=0 because μ(0)≥0 and μ(0)≤C_μ·0^d=0.
There is no outer statement quantifying over ε while holding A, B, μ, η_A, η_B, and κ fixed. Therefore the proposition does not by itself establish an asymptotic O(ε) or O(ε²) result.
The norm is abstract and restricted only by the five supplied axioms. It need not be a particular operator, Frobenius, or entrywise norm.

No numerical algorithm, sequence of arithmetic operations, rounding model, or executable computation is encoded. C is simply a matrix certified by an exact algebraic relationship and accompanying bounds.
No invertibility, conditioning, normalization, relative-error statement, componentwise perturbation bound, or bound on the full error C-AB is encoded.
There are no existential witnesses in the conclusion; all witnesses and proofs are already contained in the universally quantified run.
